name: Solvent naphtha (petroleum), hydrocracked heavy arom.; Cracked kerosine; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by the distillation of hydrocracked petroleum distillate. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons having carbon numbers predominantly in the range of C9 through C16 and boiling in the range of approximately 235 °C to 290 °C (455 °F to 554 °F).]
